_comment: Explicit MCP tool allowlist. Only tools listed here (or in a server's own "tools" config) are offered to the model.
Levels: read | write | high_risk. write/high_risk also need MCP_ALLOWED_RISKY_TOOLS=<server>__<tool> or the server's "allow_tools".
Keys under "servers" are MCP_SERVERS[].name values, or a "tool_profile" a server config refers to.
Unlisted tools are hidden and refused; the dashboard /api/health shows them as unclassified_tools so they can be reviewed.

android-phone._source: docs/TOOLS.md of the MCP repository (Violet MCP 1.3.0, formerly 1.2.x-eve): server-side read-only whitelist of 14 tools

violet-web._source: Built-in web MCP server (ai/web/mcp_server.py, phase 5B). Both tools only read public web pages through SafeFetcher.

violet-schedule._source: Built-in timetable MCP server (ai/schedule/mcp_server.py, phase 9.4.2). All four tools only read the user's timetable through ScheduleStore.
